name: judge
description: Approval as a multisig of agents. A panel's creator sets the params: the judges that sit on it (LLM agents with criteria prompts, or deterministic rule judges), the approval threshold (0-100) and the quorum. Every judge scores an input 0-100; if the weighted average falls under the threshold, or too few judges manage to vote, the verdict is FAIL. Errors fail closed. Every new judge is issued a keyring of multiple key types — classical ed25519 plus the quantum-resistant ml-dsa-65 (FIPS 204) and wots-sha256 (stdlib hash-based) — and every vote is signed by the whole ring, so the append-only verdict record is tamper-evident (GET /verify). One local SQLite file; core is stdlib, ed25519/ml-dsa use the cryptography and dilithium-py libs when present.

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is, with store stats
endpoints.GET /health: Liveness — touches only the local file
endpoints.GET /panels: Every panel, with params and verdict counts
endpoints.GET /verdicts: The verdict record, newest first (panel, limit, offset)
endpoints.GET /verdict: One verdict with every judge's score and reason (id)
endpoints.GET /verify: Re-check every signature on one verdict (id) — tamper check
endpoints.GET /key_kinds: The signature key types judges are issued (classical + quantum-resistant)
endpoints.POST /judge: Put an input before a panel {panel, input} — avg score vs threshold
endpoints.POST /create_panel: Create a panel {name, creator, judges, threshold, min_votes} — loopback callers only
endpoints.POST /update_panel: Change params {name, creator, ...} — creator only, loopback only
endpoints.POST /remove_panel: Delete a panel {name, creator} — creator only, loopback only
